text:
zoe: Hey @people-ops — two folks on my squad have confirmed parental leave windows that overlap (mid-July to mid-Aug). Need a compact to-do: paperwork deadlines, coverage options, and any payroll/benefits pitfalls for overlapping top-ups. Trying to finalize before planning week.

people-ops: Quick starter checklist: 1) Employees submit Parental Leave Request form ASAP, 2) Confirm FMLA/state eligibility, 3) Enroll in company top-up before payroll cutoff (15th), 4) Upload birth/adoption docs within 30 days. Aim for 30 days notice but we can accommodate shorter. Form: https://hr.redwood.example/forms/parental-leave

payroll: Note on pay: if both take pay-topup, we run a combined-pay model to prevent overpayment w/ state benefits (e.g., CA PFL). Top-up enrollment must be in before the payroll window closing for the first paid week — otherwise pay is retro. Send tentative dates + last paystub PDF and well draft a projection.

zoe: Thanks. For coverage we're considering: 1) internal rotation + heavier pairing, 2) short-term contractor for oncall (6	6 weeks), or 3) split model (contractor for paging, team for roadmap). How long to onboard a temp?

hiring-ops-bot: Temp flow: manager headcount note, short role bullets, hourly cap, preferred vendor (optional). Fast-track timeline: ~8-12 business days for SOW + vendor onboarding if urgent flag set.

carter: I can document a 1-page runbook and two 10-min Looms this week (deploy + pager). Recommend two pairing sessions in the final 2 weeks.

people-ops: Minimal runbook template: deploy steps, top 5 alerts + triage play, escalation contacts, one-week failover checklist. Sample rota:
```
Week -2 to 0: runbook + pair shadowing
Week 1-2: contractor onboarding + shadowing OR internal rotation ramp
Week 3+: contractor handles routine ops; team owns roadmap
```

zoe: Please open hiring ops ticket so I can include hourly cap if we go contractor. Also confirm whether benefits continuity (health/FSAs) changes during paid top-up.

people-ops: Opening ticket now. Health benefits remain active during paid company leave. If someone goes unpaid after top-up ends, payroll triggers COBRA paperwork. FSAs may need plan admin review for mid-year election changes; benefits@redwood.example can advise.

payroll: One more gotcha: overlapping leaves can affect supplemental tax elections and dependent-care pre-tax benefits. We'll run the numbers when you provide dates.

hiring-ops-bot: Ticket HR-TEMP-9922 created. Add hourly cap + start date to move forward; procurement cc'd.

zoe: Great — I'll ask both to submit forms tonight and share dates. Carter will start the runbook PR. Thanks everyone.

benefits-bot: Attached manager handoff checklist and temp hiring spec: https://hr.redwood.example/checklists/parental-overlap. :white_check_mark:
